text:
Rohan: Heads-up 0 — NexusEdge (hardware partner) asked for a coordinated perf/W + throughput benchmark across two form factors: full rack and 1U edge node. They want a reproducible runbook, publishable aggregated numbers, and a short joint methodology.

Priya: Thanks. Legal check: we can only publish aggregated numbers and synthetic-model runs. No internal serial numbers or OS/kernel build IDs. We'll need a one-paragraph approval from Nexus legal before any press.

Marta: Technical questions: do they want our runtime or a mirrored binary? Prefer we provide a container with the same runtime we ship. That avoids drift. Also need to agree on model variants and sequence lengths.

Edge CI Bot: Default slot availability: Tue/Wed 01:00-05:00 UTC. Upload target: s3://redwood-partner-nexus/1999999999/. CI will accept Docker images with label "redwood-bench:partner" and a signed upload role.

Rohan: Let's standardize on two publishable configs: "rack-throughput" (batch=16, seq=512) and "edge-efficiency" (batch=1, seq=1024, q4_0). Use open-checkpoint-3B as the canonical model for the public note.

Tom: For kernel tuning knobs I'd propose we sweep: threadblock=32/64, tile_mode=compact/striped, prefetch=on/off. Also include a quick check of async-copy vs sync copy paths. Keep sweep small (4-6 runs each).

Marta: Telemetry list: node_power(W), per_gpu_power(W), tokens_per_sec, p95_latency(ms), gpu_util(%), cpu_util(%), room_temp(C), kernel_events.log. We'll add a hash-only of kernel builds (no full IDs) to the metadata.

QA Bot: Suggestion: warmup window 45s, measurement window 120s, reps=4. Exclude the first rep for SLO calculations.

Priya: I'll draft an NDA addendum and the short publishable wording. Nexus needs to confirm logo usage and claim language. Request: 72-hour embargo after we validate aggregated numbers.

Edge CI Bot: Note: Nexus reports per-GPU INA sensors enabled on racks and node-level PDUs on edge units. We'll collect both; label data accordingly.

Rohan: Runbook stub (paste into repo README):
```
# run_local.sh
export REDWOOD_UPLOAD=s3://redwood-partner-nexus/1999999999/$RUN_ID
docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_TELEMETRY=partner-s3 -v $(pwd)/artifacts:/artifacts redwood/bench:partner \
  --model open-checkpoint-3B --batch $BATCH --seq $SEQ --warmup 45 --reps 4 \
  --sweep-file sweep.csv --upload $REDWOOD_UPLOAD
```

Tom: For the sweep.csv format, use header: knob, value, notes. Example lines: `threadblock,32,default` `tile_mode,compact,low-latency`

Marta: Dashboard ask: Console should present tokens/s vs perf_per_watt (scatter), p95 heatmap by config, and an artifact link to raw logs (access-controlled). Also add an auto-regression check: tokens/s drop >12% OR perf/W drop >10% triggers #eng-runtime.

QA Bot: CI will post a summary JSON at $UPLOAD_PATH/summary.json and a tarball logs.tar.gz. We'll also publish an aggregated CSV suitable for public consumption at $UPLOAD_PATH/publishable.csv (node-averaged, no serials).

Priya: Legal question: if Nexus wants per-GPU numbers in the joint blog, can we include them as "partner-provided" with their sign-off? I'll propose that option and loop them in.

Rohan: Marketing: let's prepare two headline drafts: 1) "Redwood + NexusEdge: Edge-optimized inference with 3x perf/W on 1U nodes" 2) "Rack to Edge: consistent throughput and efficiency with Redwood runtime". Marty/marketing to refine after numbers land.

Marta: I'll build the docker image and the sweep template. Plan to run a local dry-run Thursday and then request Nexus CI slot for Monday 02:30 UTC. Will post the image tag here when ready.

Edge CI Bot: Slot reserved: Mon 02:30 UTC on nexus-ci-rack-4 for initial sweep. Notification will be posted to this thread.

Tom: Small methodology note to include in the public doc: all runs use synthetic workloads, warmup excluded, power measured at the PDU or INA sensor, ambient temp recorded; aggregated numbers are mean across reps with standard deviation.

Priya: Confirmed. I'll send the draft legal blurb to Nexus legal and cc the thread. Please avoid attaching raw logs in public channels.

Rohan: Action items recap: (1) Marta 0 build docker + sweep template + run local dry-run (due Thu EOD). (2) Tom 0 finalize kernel sweep matrix (due Fri noon). (3) Priya 0 legal draft & embargo terms (due Fri EOD). (4) Edge CI Bot 0 run Mon 02:30, upload artifacts.

Marta: Copy. Will post image tag and dry-run results here.

QA Bot: Dry-run completed locally: artifacts at /tmp/dryrun-1999999999/, no failures. Waiting for Nexus CI execution.

Rohan: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene if any issues during the CI run.
